set.wind.mode.help: Moving air, as outdoors: it pushes the drone and carries it along, blows harder higher above the ground, and comes in gusts. The scan's wind is the one its author or the admin set for the place; live is the real wind there right now (scans with a known location); custom is your own wind for this scan.
set.wind.fromDeg.help: Where the wind comes from, in compass degrees: 0 north, 90 east, 180 south, 270 west. On a scan without a compass heading, 0 is the direction the scan faces at the start.
set.wind.speed.help: Mean speed 10 m above the ground, as a weather forecast gives it. Near the ground it is weaker, higher up stronger. A small whoop already struggles at 8-10 m/s.
set.wind.gust.help: How far the wind rises and drops around its mean speed. Gusts come and go over a few seconds; 0 is a steady wind.
wind.hud.head: headwind
wind.row.now: The live wind is fetched when you go on flying. If the scan has no known location: {fallback}
wind.row.noCompass: This scan has no compass heading: 0° is the direction it faces at the start.
wind.note.nowFallbackScene: No live wind for this scan (no known location): flying its own wind
wind.note.nowNone: No live wind for this scan (no known location): still air
